description: Whether you operate a single truck or manage an entire fleet, choosing the right International truck service center can make a significant difference in your uptime, operating costs, and overall peace of mind.

props.text: What a dealer service department does differently

Whether you operate a single truck or manage an entire fleet, choosing the right International truck service center can make a significant difference in your uptime, operating costs, and overall peace of mind.
An International truck dealer service department works on International trucks every day. That focus shows up in diagnostic accuracy, in parts availability and in how long a truck stays in the bay.
What a service visit should include
Whatever the repair, these are the things worth expecting from the department you hand your truck to.

items.label: Factory-trained technicians
items.desc: Technicians who know current engines, electrical systems, emissions technology, diagnostics and manufacturer repair procedures rather than learning them on your truck.

items.label: Accurate diagnosis
items.desc: Experience means identifying the root cause quickly and recommending the right repair the first time, instead of working through parts.

items.label: Clear communication
items.desc: You should be kept informed through the repair, with recommended services explained, so there are no surprises on the invoice.

items.label: Genuine OEM parts
items.desc: Immediate access to parts designed for your truck, which is usually the difference between a repair finished today and one waiting on a supplier.

props.text: Sales, parts and service under one roof

Our service departments are equipped to handle a wide range of maintenance and repair work for all makes and models, not only International units. Having sales, parts and service in the same building means a diagnosis does not have to wait on a parts order from somewhere else, and a unit that needs replacing rather than repairing can be discussed in the same visit.
The priorities are straightforward: quality repairs, honest communication, and getting you back on the road as quickly as we can. If a repair is not worth doing, we will tell you that too.
